fixed.summary: A lockstep tick's cost now counts the world's snapshot and hash taken after it, so a rollback peer's maxPredictionTicks budget (the ticks it can re-simulate in half a frame) is no longer over-estimated; dump_room reports it as cost { tickMs, keepMs, rewindMs }.

The per-tick hash reads the snapshot's columns in place instead of decoding every entity (about half the time, the same values), and the snapshot kept for a rollback is shared with the one kept for comparison instead of copied.
